---
title: "Launching this website"
description: "What this site contains and how records on it are kept accurate."
date: 2026-11-01
categories: [Professional Updates]
---

This website brings together my research, publications, engineering projects and academic activities in one place.

Every record on the site is maintained in a single structured source and states its status explicitly: work that is *under review*, *submitted* or a *preprint* is labelled as such, simulation studies are distinguished from experimental measurements, and appointments are listed with their official titles.

Research notes, engineering notes and conference reflections will be added here over time.
